requirement_dispositions.scope: Participant-policy noninterference, exact-cut policy and release, adaptive low strategies, memory, projection, scheduler/environment, and order coordinates remain canonical.
requirement_dispositions.rationale: Predicate opacity composes the incumbent participant information-flow carrier but is neither an amendment nor an alias of policy noninterference.

requirement_dispositions.scope: One-sided participant-relative predicate opacity, observer information cells, supervisor visibility, relation profiles, exact relation boundaries, and independent assurance states.
requirement_dispositions.rationale: No existing requirement owns selected-secret opacity or the knowledge leakage caused by supervisor decisions and behavior.

requirement_dispositions.scope: Bounded falsification, finite-state model-checking and proof evidence, relation claim bindings, adversarial cases, and backend conformance.
requirement_dispositions.rationale: ASR-535 already owns participant information-flow assurance and prevents finite evidence from becoming a universal claim.

requirement_dispositions.scope: Fail-closed reference-runtime mediation, append-only decisions and evidence, and explicit realization boundaries for supported opacity profiles.
requirement_dispositions.rationale: Opacity enforcement is a participant information-flow crossing concern; a second runtime policy engine or store is unnecessary.

requirement_dispositions.scope: Backend feature strength, required contracts, limitations, disclosure, and evidence for actually supported opacity profiles.
requirement_dispositions.rationale: The existing participant-feature support vector can express opacity support without an opacity boolean or parallel manifest.

worked_examples.observation_basis: Secret point a and nonsecret point b have equal projected histories; secret point c has a unique history.
worked_examples.expected_result: Opacity fails at c although the bounded pair a,b supplies one valid witness.
worked_examples.nonclaim: One equal-history pair does not discharge the universal actual-secret-point quantifier.

worked_examples.observation_basis: Payload projections agree, but the supervisor denies in the secret world and approves in the nonsecret world.
worked_examples.expected_result: Opacity fails when decision occurrence or outcome is retained by the observer profile.
worked_examples.nonclaim: Redacting decision content does not hide its occurrence, ordering, delivery, or latency.

worked_examples.observation_basis: Every selected-secret point has a nonsecret alternative, but two policy-low-equivalent worlds reveal a different unprotected low fact.
worked_examples.expected_result: The selected predicate is opaque while SEM-230 policy noninterference fails.
worked_examples.nonclaim: Opacity of one predicate does not imply equality of every policy-low observation.

worked_examples.observation_basis: Before release the cell has secret and nonsecret points; the authorized release splits the cell and reveals the predicate.
worked_examples.expected_result: Post-release opacity fails unless the policy no longer protects the predicate or a nonsecret alternative remains.
worked_examples.nonclaim: Later concealment or revocation does not reconstruct the earlier information cell for a remembering observer.

relation_boundaries.distinction: A unary one-sided condition requiring one nonsecret point in every actual secret information cell.
relation_boundaries.conditional_implication: is implied for eligible predicates by matching policy-noninterference
relation_boundaries.nonclaim: A definition or finite witness does not establish opacity of RAES or a backend.

relation_boundaries.distinction: A symmetric support-set hyperproperty over all selected low-equivalent variations and adaptive low strategies.
relation_boundaries.conditional_implication: implies opacity for every eligible predicate only under matching profiles
relation_boundaries.reverse_implication: is not implied by opacity of one predicate
relation_boundaries.nonclaim: Existing SEM-230 bounded evidence is not an opacity proof.

relation_boundaries.distinction: Equality of two named projected histories can supply one witness but lacks the opacity information-cell quantifier.
relation_boundaries.conditional_implication: may witness one alternative under a matching profile
relation_boundaries.reverse_implication: is not implied for arbitrary pairs by opacity

relation_boundaries.distinction: A binary same-information relation defines membership in a cell; opacity constrains secret labels across the complete cell.
relation_boundaries.conditional_implication: supplies the observer equivalence used by opacity
relation_boundaries.reverse_implication: does not follow between every pair from opacity
relation_boundaries.nonclaim: Indistinguishability alone does not name or protect a secret.

relation_boundaries.distinction: A bidirectional trace-set relation does not preserve a selected secret or observer projection without an explicit theorem.
relation_boundaries.conditional_implication: may imply opacity only with secret and observation preservation

relation_boundaries.distinction: A bidirectional step relation has different carriers and proof obligations from an information-cell secrecy condition.
relation_boundaries.conditional_implication: may imply opacity only with a secret-preserving observer mapping
relation_boundaries.nonclaim: No strong, weak, or branching bisimulation result is claimed.

assurance_lanes.evidence_required: Accepted ADR, SEM-231 formal authority, exact current behavioral-relation catalog revision, primary sources, and shared binding validation.
assurance_lanes.does_not_establish: Any system satisfies or enforces opacity.

assurance_lanes.evidence_required: Named finite cases, complete declared bounds, profile/model digests, safe counterexamples, and finite claim binding.
assurance_lanes.does_not_establish: Model checking, proof, runtime enforcement, or backend realization.

assurance_lanes.evidence_required: Pinned finite model, explored state/strategy bound, tool/version, digest, result or counterexample, and model-check binding.
assurance_lanes.does_not_establish: A theorem outside the exact finite model or runtime/backend behavior.

assurance_lanes.evidence_required: Explicit theorem, assumptions, proof artifact, checker/version when mechanized, digest, and reproduction.
Complete supported observation-channel inventory, boundary security tests, durable decisions, limitations, and runtime claim binding.
assurance_lanes.does_not_establish: General opacity, mathematical proof, or backend-native realization.

assurance_lanes.evidence_required: API-407 feature strength, required contracts, limitations, disclosures, and evidence references.
Native implementation identity, supported profile, exact contract mapping, environment, provenance, and realization evidence.
assurance_lanes.does_not_establish: Universal opacity or conformance outside the named realization.

assurance_lanes.evidence_required: Named adversarial cases, backend/profile/environment digests, sanitized failures, result records, and finite evidence boundary.
assurance_lanes.does_not_establish: Model checking, proof, cross-backend equivalence, or universal opacity.

implementation_issues.bounded_outcome: Closed opacity profiles, cross-reference resolution, and finite falsification harness.
explicit_nonclaims: No model check, proof, runtime enforcement, or backend realization.

implementation_issues.bounded_outcome: Finite-state model checking over closed SEM-231 profiles and exact strategy/order bounds.
explicit_nonclaims: No unbounded or mathematical proof, runtime enforcement, supervisor synthesis, backend realization, probabilistic result, timed result, or partial-order result.

implementation_issues.bounded_outcome: Proof-bearing opacity kernel, knowledge characterization, and matching-profile SEM-230 implication.
negative_cases: untimed result lifted to stronger variants
explicit_nonclaims: No runtime enforcement, supervisor synthesis, or backend realization.

implementation_issues.bounded_outcome: Fail-closed reference-runtime enforcement for an explicitly supported subset of SEM-231 profiles.
explicit_nonclaims: No general opacity, proof, supervisor synthesis, or backend-native realization.

implementation_issues.bounded_outcome: API-407 declaration, native realization evidence, and bounded adversarial backend conformance for named opacity profiles.
negative_cases: runtime mediation reported as backend native
secret material in reports or process surfaces
